tips.title: Smoking Impact
tips.text: Smoking increases insurance cost by 3-4x. Quitting could save you ₹1,697,435 annually.

tips.title: BMI Advisory
tips.text: Your BMI (33.2) is above normal range. Maintaining a healthy weight can reduce costs significantly.

tips.title: Age Factor
tips.text: Regular health check-ups are recommended. Preventive care can help manage insurance costs.

reasons.detail: Smoking is the #1 cost driver, increasing premiums by 3-4x compared to non-smokers.
BMI of 33.2 is in the obese range (30+). Weight management can reduce premiums.
Age 55 enters the higher risk bracket. Regular health screenings recommended.
2 dependent(s) add a small amount to the base premium.

explanation.summary: Your profile indicates high medical expense risk. Consider comprehensive coverage.

recommendation.reason: High risk due to smoking and elevated BMI. Comprehensive coverage recommended with critical illness rider.
